description: email.rs find_immutable_patch_key checks key.as_bytes().get(field.len()) == Some(&b'/') to distinguish 'messageId' (blocked) from 'messageId/0' (blocked) from 'messageIdX' (allowed). A naive starts_with check would incorrectly block the third case. This is subtle and a contributor might 'simplify' it to starts_with. The byte-index check is the right approach and is clearly commented. Do not simplify.
title: find_immutable_patch_key byte-index check is correct and necessary
